factors: Five distinct substantive arguments across science, AGI evaluation, medicine and oversight
Seven material claims and consequential distinctions between capability, outcome and authority
complexity.rationale: The profile crosses scientific, clinical and governance domains, so the Reader requires substantial source mapping, serious counterargument and explicit evidence limits.

sourceMap.rationale: This section retains the genuine AlphaFold2 success while limiting it to structure prediction rather than a general-intelligence forecast.
This section separates a reported two-to-three-year prediction and proposed Einstein benchmark from independently measured progress.
This section compares first-party intermediate research reports with the missing prospective patient-outcome evidence.
This section contrasts a reported industry-funded oversight proposal with a documented but first-party safety framework.
This section states the original GhostMesh distinction between capability evidence, outcome evidence and binding deployment authority.

sourceCoverage.rationale: Five distinct sections map the partner-reported profile themes and separate primary materials. No video time or unobserved original WSJ passage is invented.

supportingArgument.rationale: The profile’s strongest scientific achievement, forecast, originality challenge, drug-development ambition and governance proposal are represented with attribution.

evidenceRoles.rationale: Reported interview predictions, first-party company statements, independent scientific explanation, proposals and GhostMesh inference are labeled separately.

counterargument.rationale: The Reader grants AlphaFold its bounded scientific success and acknowledges DeepMind’s published safety process before testing broader inferences.

tradeoffs.rationale: The essay considers scientific optimism alongside measurement boundaries, clinical handoffs and who may make deployment refusals binding.

falsifiability.rationale: The analysis names forecast definitions, contamination controls, patient-outcome baselines and enforceable oversight evidence that could change its judgment.

originalSynthesis.rationale: The original GhostMesh thesis separates a model’s capability, verified mission outcome and authorized release, including handoff and recovery requirements.

performance.rationale: AlphaFold2 accuracy is discussed only in high-confidence regions and AGI evaluation is framed as a measurement challenge rather than a benchmark result.

economics.rationale: This profile and locked analysis do not make a cost or efficiency claim. No unreported economic estimate is inferred from company ambitions.

threatGovernance.rationale: The Reader identifies evaluation authority, funding, evidence access, publication of adverse findings and deployment-stop power as distinct control questions.

gaps.rationale: The complete original WSJ HTML was not independently compared with the credited readable partner edition; exact original-only wording should remain outside claims until accessible.

decisionRationale: The independent read-only review of the exact unchanged article, mapped public evidence and source limits found no blocking factual or privacy issue. Tony supplied and approved the locked analysis; authenticated acceptance of these exact PR bytes by his direct GitHub comment remains required before release.
